title: AUDIT → GAP → CONSTRAINED PROMPT
subtitle: Check what's built, target what fits — no blank-canvas prompts
key_concept: A three-step workflow that audits existing infrastructure, identifies gaps, and generates constrained prompts

highlights: Discovered via Thinking Companion (STRUCTURE lens, first live use)
